text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Huff, huff...! Okay!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm in tip-top shape! Shall we head to the 
land where romance gathers? Before this 
excitement cools down!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's about the right time.

text_block_list.text:
"With the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe just 
around the corner, Tap Dance City made her 
final adjustments at her familiar training 
grounds. It was her wish to arrive on-site 
in peak condition."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, it's finally here, the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe! It makes my legs want 
to dance all on their own!

It's about an hour from here to Longchamp. 
We departed with plenty of time to spare, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Darn it! Why won't this move at all?!

"The car we boarded was stuck in terrible 
traffic. Time ticked away, second by 
second. Any delay in our arrival would 
directly wear her down..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...And tomorrow is race day, too... 
You're kidding me!"
choice_data_list: (I've got to calm them down somehow...)

text_block_list.text:
The best-case preparation is no longer an 
option, but I want to aim for the next 
best thing. —Just then, the phone rang.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Ah, it's me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Tap... judging by the sound, are you still 
on the bus? Are you stuck in traffic by 
any chance? --Actually, so are we.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
We made it into Paris, but we're 
completely stuck. Apparently there's an 
accident causing traffic. The taxi driver 
says we won't be moving anytime soon—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then aren't things pretty chaotic on your 
end? Are you holding up okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
"We're totally fine! In fact, that's our 
line! —Tap, we're gonna make sure you get 
to the hotel ASAP!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "...What? What does that mean?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
One of our friends who came to France just 
got out of the car to gather intel. 
They're asking the locals around here 
about shortcuts.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
"I tried social media! A kind person 
translated it into French for me~ and I 
got a few replies!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
“Still, there's no way we could figure out 
which route is the fastest on our own...”

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
You're the best! Trainer, I leave it to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
"—Tap, all you need to think about is the 
race."
choice_data_list: Yeah. Leave everything else to us.
Yeah. Leave everything else to us.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Okay! Got it! I'm counting on you all!

And so, making full use of social media 
and on-site info, we successfully figured 
out the fastest detour. Before long, we 
managed to arrive at our destination!

—Before heading to the hotel, Tap Dance 
City told me she wanted to stop by 
Longchamp Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...I'm finally here. A ship that nearly 
ran aground has safely reached its 
destination at last.
choice_data_list:
It's all thanks to everyone—to our 
friends!

It's all thanks to everyone—to our 
friends!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. People told me it was reckless to 
bring along my peers all the way to 
France, that I should just leave them 
behind.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Without my comrades, there's no way I 
could've taken on the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe feeling this great!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Tomorrow is my turn. The dream everyone 
passed on to me—I'm gonna make it bloom 
with a bang!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna laugh at my foolish dream, go 
ahead and laugh! I'll claim wealth and 
glory at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
and build myself a humongous castle!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So I can live freely and happily with my 
friends forever!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Our dream will come true!
